title: Clean control — no planted issues
whyThisCase: A document with specific actors and operations and one measurable lockout rule. There are no planted ambiguities or contradictions. Extra detections still print in the live pipeline UI; this gold file just asserts there is nothing we required the harness to catch. Use it to see false-positive noise, not as a zero-tolerance test.

mustExtract.note: Automated lock with a numeric bound.

mustNotDetect.note: Control copy of the 'the system' actor rule.
